name: downshift-router
description: Experimental: routes each subagent's model from the agent.spawn event by calling the downshift binary in-process. Off unless enabled; the settings PreToolUse hook stays the supported path.

enabled.title: Route subagents from agent.spawn
enabled.description: Off by default. When on, every agent.spawn runs `downshift claude-code` and applies the model it writes. DOWNSHIFT_MOD_ROUTER=1 in the environment enables it too.

binary.title: downshift binary
binary.description: Command or absolute path of the downshift binary (default: downshift on PATH).
